# Rumble sub-actions

![Adding a sub-action: on the Actions page, click + Sub-action and search for it](../../assets/screens/actions-sub-action-picker.png)

## Send chat message

Writes a message in your Rumble live chat. Needs you to be signed in to Rumble chat and live right now.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Message** | What to write, like "Welcome in, %user%!". |

<small>Type id: `rumble.sendMessage`</small>
